notes:
New: Quick replies. Saved one-click replies like 'Thanks, got it!', with a switch for whether to add your greeting and sign-off. You can also turn the greeting and sign-off off for any single reply.

New: Notifications. A Windows notification when a check finds emails that need you, even while the app is minimized.

New: Sending pace. Replies go out one at a time with a natural pause between them, never instantly after an email arrives, and up to an hourly limit, so nothing looks automated. You can cancel a reply while it's waiting.

Also: proper checkmarks in checkboxes.
